biography: Born in Melbourne to a family with a modest background, Alex Davison's racing journey began unconventionally. While his peers were karting, Alex was tinkering with his father's old Holden, learning the mechanics of machines. His entry into competitive racing was delayed, but at 22, he scraped together enough funds to enter a state-level Formula Ford series. His raw talent was evident, but his inconsistency plagued him. One race he'd be on the podium; the next, he'd be in the gravel trap. That inconsistency followed him into V8 Supercars, where he bounced around smaller teams before landing at Fizz Flavor Racing. While he's shown flashes of brilliance, a championship has remained elusive. Now at 38, Davison is considered a veteran of the sport, a respected driver with a reputation for unpredictable performances. He’s known for pulling off incredible overtakes one weekend and then binning it into the wall the next.
drivingStyle: Davison's driving style can be best described as a high-risk, high-reward approach. He's aggressive on the brakes, often throwing the car into corners with a late apex. He has a knack for finding grip where others can't, which leads to spectacular overtakes but also costly mistakes. Tire management isn't his forte; he tends to overdrive the car early in stints, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps. Under pressure, he's prone to errors, sometimes cracking under the strain of a close battle.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Bathurst in 2018 where Bellini accused Davison of deliberately wrecking him.

rivalries.name: Zara Petrova
rivalries.reason: A constant battle on track for mid-pack positions, often resulting in aggressive defensive maneuvers and heated radio exchanges.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities - Tanaka's calculated approach contrasting sharply with Davison's 'send it' mentality, leading to frequent on-track incidents.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, despite their increasingly questionable condition.
Listens to classical music on noise-canceling headphones right up until the minute he gets into the car.
Has to have exactly three jellybeans – always black – before every race, claiming they bring him focus.
famousQuote: Sometimes you gotta risk it for the biscuit, even if the biscuit ends up in the fence.
careerHighlight: Winning the Sandown 500 in 2015 with a late-race charge, overtaking two cars in the final lap after a strategic gamble on tires.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Bathurst 1000 in 2019 with only 10 laps to go, costing his team a guaranteed victory and earning him a deluge of criticism.
